Admissible evidence shows aggregate readiness passed by 2.0 percentage points and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and public governance guidance supports deployment with documented limitations plus ongoing measurement and monitoring. At the same time, the same admissible record shows the multilingual customer support segment misses target by 1.1 percentage points, that segment is named in two regional support commitments, and legal review on disclosure remains open. On that record, the appropriate treatment is to preserve the locked certification decision only as caveated compliance or no escalation, not as an unrestricted compliant finding.
